item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J03540","case1_error":"Counts only two houses instead of Zion's house plus his two friends' houses.","case2_error":"Triples the already combined bedroom time for the living room and divides work among four people instead of three.","reason":"Case 1 omits a house from the total; case 2 misapplies an equality and uses an incorrect worker count.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03541","case1_error":"Reports unsupported $100 after a correct profit formula; also drops necessary parentheses in the expanded profit-per-mile expression.","case2_error":"Omits the cow's $600 purchase price from total expenses, overstating profit.","reason":"Case 1 gives an unsupported result and malformed expression; case 2 excludes a required expense from its cost model.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03542","case1_error":"Leading answer marker says 600, but the derivation and concluding answer correctly give 400 legs.","case2_error":"Allocates all Tuesday's available time to poodles, omitting two hours for Chihuahuas.","reason":"Case 1 has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J03543","case1_error":"Leading marker says 15, while the correct derivation and conclusion give 21 pancakes.","case2_error":"Leading marker says 5, while the correct derivation and conclusion give $4 per ring.","reason":"Both cases contain only contradictory answer markers with otherwise correct mathematics.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J03544","case1_error":"Uses an incorrect conversion factor of 1.16 ounces per pound instead of 16.","case2_error":"Subtracts one month's growth from the annual shortfall, incorrectly evaluates 6 − 1/3 as 1/3, and fails to average annually.","reason":"Case 1 uses a false unit conversion; case 2 mixes time periods and incorrectly evaluates an explicitly written subtraction.","judgment":"different"}]}
